events.title: Jimi Hendrix would have been 84
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84 today. His groundbreaking guitar work continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' iconic frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and songwriting for The Pretenders have left an indelible mark on rock.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam G Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger after all these years. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released (1975)
events.blurb: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' first asked us to envision a better world. Its message of peace and unity remains as powerful as ever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today is James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British spy franchise which premiered its first film in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Favourite
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your ultimate Bond moment? Let us know your favourite 007 film or song.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we pay tribute to the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to resonate globally.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy, from Monty Python to Fawlty Towers.

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, whose incredible voice and stage presence continue to captivate. He would have been 80 today.

events.title: The Beatles release 'Rubber Soul' (1965)
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul'.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly marked a shift in their sound and songwriting. A timeless classic.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic death of John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on the anniversary of his passing. His profound impact on music and culture continues to inspire generations.
